title: egg cups 2 pc
text: egg cups 2 pc. I waited to review these cups until I had used them for a while.  I ordered 4 of them (2 pcs in each order).  They are very sturdy.  Dishwasher without issue.  They stack easily and solidly.  They hold the egg perfectly and the oval side allows you to place the top, or a spoon right next to the egg.  I fully peel my eggs (personal preference) and cut my toast into sticks to dip with... then I just pick up the egg and eat it.... but it worked just as well leaving the shell and topping it.  I like the heavy white porcelain and the sort of modern oval base.  I also love that they stack (wasn't really expecting that) and they wash up easily and safely in the dishwasher. I estimate the ovals are about 3 1/2 to 4" at the longest point. They look so nice on the breakfast table in my opinion.  I like that they are the usual "egg tower" cup - I usually knock those over - but I am a classic klutz too.  :)  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. I do hope this info was useful to you as it is the only reason I bother to write my fully uncompensated reviews!  :)

product_metadata.title: Küchenprofi Set of 2 Egg Cups with Oval Base, White Porcelain Egg Holders for Hard or Soft Boiled Eggs, 3.5-Inch by 4-Inch
features: CLASSIC, ELEGANT EGG CUPS: Add a little elegance to your breakfast routine with these beautiful Egg Cups with Oval Base. Egg cups are the classic way to serve boiled eggs at breakfast, brunch, or lunch. Shipped in sets of 2, each egg cup features a perfectly proportioned pedestal to hold eggs upright so you can remove the top and easily enjoy the rest of your egg.

QUALITY MATERIALS & DESIGN: These stylish cups are crafted of chip resistant porcelain and are sure to match any table setting or decor. Unlike an inferior plastic egg holder, each white porcelain egg cup makes an impressive display as you serve your morning eggs. Each egg cup comes with an oval base, designed to make carrying and serving easy.

KEEPS YOUR EGGS FRESH: When eating breakfast or brunch, you want to make sure that your food is fresh from the first bite to the last. These porcelain egg cups hold your egg neatly and securely, throughout the entire meal. These egg plates are perfect for both soft and hard boiled eggs and are sturdy enough to support most egg sizes.

CONVENIENT & EASY TO USE: These egg cups are not only big on style, but they are also big on convenience. They are strong enough for everyday use and are microwave safe, oven safe, and stackable for easy, compact storage. For added convenience, they clean up in a snap. You can wash them with soap and hot water or place them right into your dishwasher. Dimensions: 4" L x 3.5" W.

TRADITION OF QUALITY: Küchenprofi was founded in Germany in 1923. Designing quality items has distinguished this brand as one of the best in the industry. They strive to bring imagination and creativity to the home cook's kitchen and to enhance your overall cooking experience. Frieling has partnered with this brand since 2017 and proudly brings its premium quality hand tools, salt and pepper mills, and more to the US market.
